title: Validate archive extraction paths
why: Archive entries can escape the intended destination through traversal paths or unsafe link metadata.
suggestion: Validate every resolved member path against the destination, or use the tar data filter where supported.
limitations: Receivers are tracked only from direct tarfile.open and zipfile.ZipFile assignments or one-line context managers.

Tar extraction with filter=data is accepted, as is the Python 3.14 data-filter default when pyproject.toml requires Python 3.14 or newer; custom validation helpers for zip extraction are not inferred, so this hotspot is advisory by default.
